headline: India's Cabinet backs a women's quota and delimitation push while markets slide on inflation and rate fears, and AI job-cut worries grow.

stories.title: Cabinet clears women's quota and a 50% rise in seats for states
stories.summary: India's Cabinet has cleared a delimitation push that includes a women's quota and a 50% increase in seats for states. Opposition parties are now deciding where they stand, and the DMK says its position is unchanged.
stories.why_it_matters: Redrawing seats changes how much say each state, including Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, has in Parliament.

stories.title: Suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed operative arrested in Vadodara
stories.summary: Gujarat's anti-terror squad says it caught a man linked to the Jaish-e-Mohammed terror group who planned to attack an Indian Air Force station. Police recovered an assault rifle, 23 live cartridges and a group flag.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows a real terror plot against a military site was disrupted.

stories.title: Left parties demand a judicial probe into Andhra Pradesh local body polls
stories.summary: CPI(M) alleges violence against opposition candidates and polling booth capture in several places. The Left parties also want Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign.
stories.why_it_matters: It questions how fair the recent local elections in Andhra Pradesh were.

stories.title: Failed crops leave Telangana farmers deep in debt
stories.summary: A drought linked to El Niño, a weather pattern that brings poor rain, has ruined this season's kharif crops in Telangana. Farmers face loan repayments with little support, and experts warn water scarcity could last beyond this season.
stories.why_it_matters: It points to rising rural distress in Telangana.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait; Iran denies blame
stories.summary: Two Italian technicians working for German firm Rheinmetall died in a strike in Kuwait, Italy's foreign ministry said. Iran says it was not responsible.
stories.why_it_matters: The Middle East conflict is spreading and now affects oil supply and prices.

stories.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls one seat short of a majority
stories.summary: The National Party-led bloc did not win enough seats to govern outright. Prime Minister Luxon must now bargain with a centrist kingmaker.
stories.why_it_matters: It leaves New Zealand's next government uncertain.

stories.title: Zelensky criticises Trump's 'strange' friendship with Putin
stories.summary: In a BBC interview, Ukraine's president said the US is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows peace talks to end the war are stuck.

stories.title: Sensex falls 900 points, Nifty near 25,600
stories.summary: Indian stocks dropped on a weaker rupee, renewed inflation fears and talk of a US interest rate hike. Hotter US inflation data raised the chance of a December hike, and higher oil prices added to the worry.
stories.why_it_matters: It dents SIP and index fund values in the short term.

stories.title: Gold and silver crashed in November, then bounced back
stories.summary: On India's futures market gold fell about 13% in November and silver nearly 20%, helped by a stronger US dollar and expected tighter US policy. Both rebounded on Friday, with silver hitting a 6% upper limit.
stories.why_it_matters: Gold prices are swinging sharply, which matters to anyone holding or buying gold.

stories.title: JP Morgan: AI could put 24 million knowledge-worker jobs at risk in five years
stories.summary: A JP Morgan Wealth Management report says AI could displace about 24 million office-style jobs worldwide over five years in one illustrative scenario.
stories.why_it_matters: It bears directly on how safe and in-demand different tech and office jobs will be.

stories.title: Nvidia pauses chip server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
stories.summary: Nvidia told manufacturers to stop shipping servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. The US is tightening efforts to keep AI chips out of China.
stories.why_it_matters: Chip export curbs are reshaping who can build AI.

stories.title: SAP weighs cutting at least 10,000 jobs in AI restructuring
stories.summary: The software giant is considering cutting at least 9% of its global workforce, according to people familiar with the talks. The number is not final and could change after labour negotiations.
stories.why_it_matters: It is another big sign of companies cutting jobs while shifting to AI.

stories.title: Swiggy Instamart lays off about 340 employees
stories.summary: Swiggy's quick-delivery arm is cutting around 340 corporate and support staff as part of a restructuring.
